brief:
Israeli authorities have isolated prisoners in occupation jails for one thousand days and prevented the Red Crescent from visiting them, Shehab Wire reported. The restrictions have extended continuously throughout the period, cutting off detainees from outside contact and humanitarian access.

The measure denies Palestinians held in Israeli facilities contact with family members and independent monitoring by the International Committee of the Red Crescent. The thousand-day isolation marks an extended period of restricted conditions for the imprisoned population.
